title: UNIT 1: APPLICATION OF PHYSICS IN OTHER FIELDS
notes: ✓ Physics provides principles used in science, engineering, medicine, defense and communication.

title: 1.1 PHYSICS AND OTHER SCIENCES
notes:
◆ Chemistry → atomic structure, bonding, spectroscopy, radioactivity and energy.

◆ Biology → motion, blood flow, sound, vision and biological energy.

◆ Geology → forces, heat, waves, electricity, magnetism, stress and fluids.

◆ Astronomy → mechanics, gravitation, atomic physics and electromagnetic radiation.

title: 1.2 PHYSICS AND ENGINEERING
notes:
✓ Engineering applies physics to design and build useful systems.

◆ Civil → forces, tension, elasticity and structures.

◆ Mechanical → mechanics, thermodynamics, materials and fluid systems.

◆ Electrical/Electronic → electricity, electromagnetism, circuits and semiconductors.

title: 1.3 MEDICAL PHYSICS
notes:
✓ Physics is used in medical diagnosis and treatment.

◆ X-ray → internal-body imaging.

◆ CT → computer-processed X-ray images.

◆ MRI → magnetic fields + radio waves.

◆ Ultrasound → high-frequency sound waves.

◆ Radiation therapy → treats abnormal/cancerous tissue.

title: 1.4 PHYSICS AND DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY
notes:
✓ Physics supports detection, tracking, navigation and surveillance.

◆ Radar → electromagnetic waves detect and locate objects.

◆ Infrared → night vision and thermal detection.

◆ Missile systems → mechanics, gravitation, aerodynamics, electronics and control systems.

title: 1.5 PHYSICS IN COMMUNICATION
notes:
✓ Communication uses physics to transmit and receive information.

◆ Wireless → electromagnetic waves.

◆ Wired → electrical signals through conductors.

◆ Fiber optics → light signals through optical fibers.

◆ Satellite → receives and retransmits signals.

✓ Key concepts: electromagnetic waves, electricity, electronics, reflection, refraction, diffraction and interference.

title: UNIT 1 QUICK REVIEW
notes:
◆ Science → physics supports other sciences.
◆ Engineering → physics → technology.
◆ Medicine → imaging + treatment.
◆ Defense → radar + infrared + tracking.
◆ Communication → electromagnetic waves + electronics.
